verdict.rationale: This story describes the product acting as an MCP client/host that consumes externally-plugged-in MCP servers' tools (like Claude Desktop or Cursor do). Gusto is a payroll/HR SaaS platform, not an AI agent or IDE-style host application — all Gusto evidence instead shows it publishing its own MCP server (and CLI) for others to consume, which is the opposite, server-side role and a separate axis.
